profile.title: ServiceNow Develooper
profile.tagline: Results-driven **ServiceNow Developer** with **3+ years** of IT experience specializing in ServiceNow development, platform administration, and enterprise integrations.

projects.blurb: Implemented and automated ServiceNow HRSD solutions to streamline HR case operations, lifecycle processes, and employee self-service delivery
projects.title: HR Service Delivery Implementation and Automation (HRSD)
projects.result: Streamlined HR service delivery, improved case resolution speed, and enabled seamless automated data migration for large-scale operations.
projects.problem: Manual HR requests and fragmented processes caused delays in case resolution, tracking inefficiencies, and high operational overhead across employee lifecycle workflows.
projects.approach:
Implemented and configured ServiceNow HRSD, including HR Case Management and the Employee Service Portal.

Designed custom HR Catalog Items, Case Workflows, assignment rules, case templates, and transfer cases to automate lifecycle operations.

Developed Business Rules, Client Scripts, UI Policies, and Script Includes to enforce logic and streamline case processing.

Executed bulk case creation, HR skill management, and automated data ingestion using Import Sets and Transform Maps.

Built dashboards and reports to monitor case performance, SLA compliance, and HR KPIs.

projects.blurb: mplemented ServiceNow ITOM solutions to automate infrastructure discovery, enhance CMDB health, and enable proactive enterprise monitoring.
projects.title: Enterprise IT Operations Management (ITOM) Implementation
projects.result: Reduced alert noise, improved monitoring accuracy, enhanced multi-cloud asset tracking, and achieved complete visibility into infrastructure dependencies.
projects.problem: Fragmented asset visibility, inaccurate CMDB data, and high alert noise hindered effective IT impact analysis and proactive operational monitoring.
projects.approach:
Deployed ServiceNow Discovery, MID Servers, and Credential Management for automated CI ingestion into the CMDB.

Configured Service Mapping and Application Services to establish dependency maps for accurate impact analysis.

Managed CMDB Health rules, CI relationships, and lifecycle management to optimize CMDB data quality.

Implemented Event Management with alert correlation and Event Rules to minimize alert noise and streamline operational response.

Integrated AWS and Azure Cloud Discovery for unified multi-cloud infrastructure visibility and asset management.

Automated workflows using IntegrationHub, Flow Designer, and REST/SOAP APIs, while monitoring coverage via Performance Analytics dashboards.

projects.blurb: Designed and automated an integrated Employee Onboarding application to coordinate provisioning workflows across HR, IT, and Facilities.
projects.title: Employee Onboarding Application (ITSM)
projects.result: Achieved a 30% reduction in onboarding turnaround time and a 25% reduction in manual HR effort.
projects.problem: Manual onboarding processes led to communication delays and friction across HR, IT, and Facilities, slowing down time-to-productivity for new hires.
projects.approach:
Designed an end-to-end onboarding application using Service Catalog and Flow Designer to trigger multi-departmental provisioning tasks automatically.

Built dynamic catalog items, record producers, and conditional forms powered by Business Rules and Glide Scripting.

Configured SLAs, automated task workflows, and notifications to track access provisioning, equipment allocation, and workspace setup.

Integrated ServiceNow with external enterprise systems via REST APIs for seamless cross-platform data exchange.

Conducted data migration using Import Sets/Transform Maps and managed Update Set deployments in Agile (Scrum) sprint cycles.

projects.blurb: Modernised enterprise self-service portals using custom AngularJS widgets to enhance usability, accessibility, and service fulfillment.
projects.title: Enterprise Self-Service Portal Modernisation
projects.result: Improved user satisfaction, increased portal adoption, and enhanced system stability and speed across multi-portal environments.
projects.problem: Legacy portal interfaces lacked responsiveness, performance, and customisation, making service request submission unintuitive for users.
projects.approach:
Customized Service Portal pages, themes, and layouts to deliver responsive self-service interfaces across HR, IT, and Enterprise Service Management.

Developed dynamic custom widgets using AngularJS, HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and Server Scripts to expand portal functionality.

Integrated Catalog Items, Record Producers, Knowledge Base articles, and workflows into the portal for single-pane fulfillment.

Secured access by configuring role-based access controls (ACLs), portal security rules, and widget/client scripts.

Optimised portal responsiveness through widget customisation, debugging, and performance tuning.

education.institution: National Institute of Science and Technology, Berhampur, Odisha

highlights: Designed, customized, and deployed enterprise ServiceNow solutions across ITSM, HRSD, ITOM, and custom scoped applications following ITIL and Agile standards.
Engineered automated workflows, business logic, and security rules utilizing Business Rules, Client Scripts, UI Policies Script Includes, Flow Designer, and ACLs.
Developed AI-powered and self-service conversational workflows using Now Assist, Agentic AI, Virtual Agent, NLU, and UI Builder to enhance agent productivity and user experience.
Built robust multi-system integrations with REST/SOAP APIs, Kafka, Jira, and enterprise systems.
